description.value: Garrick's Head Pub has occupied Bastion Square since 1867, making it one of the oldest English pubs in Canada and a genuine Victorian-era institution. The two-level pub boasts an outdoor patio overlooking the historic square — a welcoming stop for cyclists coming through downtown Victoria — along with a wood-burning fireplace for cooler days. The menu runs to classic pub fare alongside what the owners claim is Victoria's largest selection of craft and import beers on tap.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
